title: WAIT Update
description: Compact advisory WAIT Update output. All user-facing text values MUST be written in Indonesian. The current price is an echo of the authoritative user-entered value.

update_summary.description: Concise summary of the latest waiting observation in Indonesian.

current_price.description: Echo of the user-entered current price for display; it is not inferred by Gemini.

orderbook_assessment.description: Concise assessment of the latest orderbook in Indonesian.

broker_flow_analysis.description: Optional advisory Broker Flow 1D assessment, present only when Broker Flow evidence was supplied.

assessment.description: Semantic classification of visible daily broker flow.

analysis.description: Concise Indonesian explanation of visible broker activity and its impact on the WAIT thesis.

change_from_previous_analysis.description: Concise Indonesian description of what improved, weakened, or remained unchanged.

current_entry_condition.description: Concise Indonesian assessment of current entry readiness; it does not create a BUY decision.

upside_probability.description: Advisory upside probability from 0 to 100; it need not sum to 100 with downside_probability.

downside_probability.description: Advisory downside probability from 0 to 100; it need not sum to 100 with upside_probability.

recommended_action.description: Advisory recommendation only; it does not persist or execute a user decision.

next_plan.description: Concise advisory follow-up plan in Indonesian.

conclusion.description: Concise final advisory assessment in Indonesian.
